card.text: M39 is an open star cluster in the Milky Way, about 296 parsecs away.

sources.label: Hunt & Reffert (2023), Improving the open cluster census. II. An all-sky cluster catalogue with Gaia DR3, A&A 673, A114; CDS J/A+A/673/A114, Table 3 (clusters), Theia_517: dist50, the median of the maximum-likelihood distance, 295.86999699 pc (16th to 84th percentile 296 to 296)
Wikipedia, "Messier 39"
sources.quote: Messier 39 or M39, also known as NGC 7092, is an open cluster of stars in the constellation of Cygnus, sometimes referred to as the Pyramid Cluster.

introduction.text: M39 is drawn as 284 of its member stars, measured by Gaia; each dot sits at its sky position, at the cluster's distance.

sources.quote: It is positioned two degrees south of the star Pi Cygni and around 9° east-northeast of Deneb.
